hints.title: Prompt Quality Tips
hints.subtitle: How to write effective prompts

tips.text: Be specific about the main subject

tips.example: "in a cobblestone alley during golden hour"
"shot with 85mm lens, shallow depth of field"

hints.bestPractice: Write full sentences that describe the complete scene, not just keywords. Think "paint me a picture with words."

optimizer.title: Prompt Optimizer
optimizer.subtitle: Optimize your prompts based on Google Gemini best practices

optimizer.canEdit: You can further edit the optimized prompt.
optimizer.tip: The AI Optimizer follows Google Gemini's official best practices to refine your prompts with greater specificity and detail, providing enhanced scenario descriptions to generate higher-quality images.
